newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Kuok eyes new shares, equity-linked issues.
newsitem.headline: Kuok eyes new shares, equity-linked issues.

text.p: Kuok Philippine Properties Inc said on Tuesday it would issue preferred shares and equity-linked issues to cover an increase in its authorised capital.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange its shareholders had approved a resolution increasing its capital to ten billion pesos from the previous 3.9 billion.
It was not known when the company would raise the necessary funds.
Aside from the usual attributes of preferred shares, the Kuok preferred shares, to be worth 3.0 billion pesos, might be convertible to common shares at the option of the board, the company said.
Details of the equity-linked issue are yet to be finalised by the board, the company said.
